title: Multi-candidate ballot problem reduction to classical

problemStatement.formal: multi_candidate_ballot : uniformOn (multiCountedSequence m a b) (multiStaysPositive m) = (a - b) / (a + b)
problemStatement.plain: Generalize the ballot problem to m ≥ 2 candidates: the probability that candidate 0 leads all opponents combined throughout counting equals (a-b)/(a+b), where a = leader votes and b = total opponent votes.
whyMatters: Extends classical Wiedijk #30 to multi-candidate elections
Establishes formal connection between multi-candidate and 2-candidate settings
Provides fiber uniformity framework for probability reductions

proven: Positive fiber dichotomy (all-or-nothing by target membership)
knownResults.goal: Reduce multi-candidate ballot to classical ballot theorem

currentState.focus: Strengthened tautological proofs to use Mathlib's ballot_problem

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED+EXTENDED: Added fiber bijection infrastructure (Part VIII-B). 3 new definitions (extractOpponents, reconstructSeq, fiberSwap) and 4 proved lemmas providing the framework to eliminate fiber_card_uniform axiom. Still 2 axioms, 0 sorries. Proof roadmap documented.
builtItems: multiCountedSequence: Set of Fin m sequences with given vote profile
multiStaysPositive: Pullback of Ballot.staysPositive through projection
fiber_stays_iff_target: Target membership determines positive fiber
extractOpponents: extract non-leader values at opponent positions (BallotProblemOQ01OQ02.lean)
reconstructSeq: rebuild sequence from target + opponent values (BallotProblemOQ01OQ02.lean)
fiberSwap: compose extract+reconstruct for fiber bijection (BallotProblemOQ01OQ02.lean)
extractOpponents_length: proved length = count of -1s in target
insights: Mathlib's ballot_problem uses ProbabilityTheory.uniformOn, not condCount
List types need explicit MeasurableSpace := ⊤ instances for uniformOn
Fiber uniformity reduces to multinomial counting which is infrastructure-heavy
The positive fiber dichotomy is key: stays-positive is inherited from target
Fiber bijection via extractOpponents/reconstructSeq: extract opponent values at -1 positions, reconstruct for new target. Involutive map gives equal ncard.
mathlibGaps: MeasurableSpace instances for List types not automatically available
No multinomial coefficient infrastructure for fiber counting
nextSteps: Prove reconstructSeq_projects (reconstruct projects to target for valid opponent values)
Prove reconstruct_extract_cancel (reconstructSeq ∘ extractOpponents = id for fiber members)
Once involutive proved, fiber_card_uniform follows from bijection → equal ncard
uniformOn_fiber_transfer: still needs measure theory proof (separate from fiber bijection)
